challenges.name: monthly-sales-report-streams
challenges.title: Write the monthly sales report with streams and collectors
challenges.description: Mekong Books' monthly sales report reads one sale per line (date;isbn;title;category;qty;unitPrice) and must print revenue per category (highest first, ties A-Z), the top N titles by copies sold (the sum of qty, ties A-Z) and the totals. The same title sells on many days, so a toMap without a merge function crashes, counting() counts lines instead of copies, and a HashMap prints categories in hash order. Write report(sales, topN) with groupingBy, toMap with a merge function, sorted comparators and mapToLong. The exact output format is in the starter's header comment.
